caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate candlestick rendered in blue tones, positioned upright in the center of a cream-colored background. The candlestick has a wide, octagonal base that tapers upward through a series of angular and curved sections, creating a tiered appearance. Each section is carefully shaded to highlight the facets and curves, with darker blues used for shadows and lighter blue for highlighted surfaces. The central shaft is straight with defined vertical ridges, while the sections above and below it widen and narrow in alternating fashion. There is no candle present in the holder. The artwork is framed by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border, and the bottom right corner contains a small signature reading "R.W. Woiceske." The surrounding background remains blank, drawing attention solely to the blue candlestick.
title: Candlestick
